title: FEEL THE DROP EDM Entity Dictionary (SOT)

usage_policy.english: Preserve exact capitalization, spacing, punctuation, and accents in `en`.
usage_policy.korean_established: ko_status=established: use `ko` as the Korean output. Verified against Korean media / official festival lineups (see ko_source).
usage_policy.korean_none: ko_status=none: NO settled Korean notation exists. Keep the English form as-is. NEVER invent a Korean transliteration.
usage_policy.ko_avoid: Incorrect Korean notations that circulate but must never be output.
usage_policy.aliases_en: Accepted input variants for matching. Do not use as output.
usage_policy.weight: Entity-matching weight used by the topic suggestion pipeline.
